pattern.description: The cursor grabs the left edge of the 'Performance improvements' timeline bar and drags it back to Jan-Mar '23; the card widens in snapped column steps while its title, field labels and dots reflow with the edge.
pattern.why_premium: A direct-manipulation demo timed to 'next several quarters': the viewer sees the bar span quarters as the words land, which shows the feature instead of describing it.

build_hint.gsap: Drive cursor x with gsap.to(cursor, {x:-330, duration:0.65, ease:'power1.inOut'}) and bind the card's left edge to it via onUpdate with gsap.utils.snap(columnStep) so the width jumps in steps; the inner text is left-aligned so it follows the edge with no separate tween.
build_hint.remotion: const x = interpolate(frame, [start, end], [0, -330], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight:'clamp'}); cardLeft = Math.round(x / step) * step; cursor uses raw x, card uses snapped value; no spring.

notes: Energy shows regular spikes between near-zero frames, consistent with snapped drag steps (or a low capture frame rate). The vacated area of the old dot position (b04) is not listed separately as it is the same dots element.
